dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible geometric narrowing of the planar width from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized concave deviation on the right lateral margin approximately halfway down the visible body length.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity reflectance across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast vertical linear mark is visible on the central dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A longitudinal topological crease or indentation is visible along the central dorsal axis posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small vertical linear mark or indentation is located centrally on the dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark circular aperture is visible at the anterior dorsal position.
